summary: Iran's Supreme Leader's office published a letter from Mojtaba Khamenei to Hezbollah declaring defense of all Lebanese territory and a complete end to Israeli invasion as the primary condition for any war-ending agreement with the U.S. The IDF struck central Gaza, killing Hamas UAV commander Mahmoud Id, and separately eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza involved in weapons production and the Nukhba Force. Meanwhile, the Israeli security cabinet is set to discuss a pilot program for humanitarian rehabilitation in Rafah under a Palestinian technocrat government backed by a multinational force.
key_points: Mojtaba Khamenei's letter to Hezbollah sets defense of all Lebanese territory and unconditional end to Israeli invasion as first condition for any agreement to end the forced war with the U.S. (Source: @New_security8200/203002)

IDF killed Hamas UAV squad commander Mahmoud Id in central Gaza, citing his responsibility for UAV production targeting Israeli civilians and soldiers and efforts to rebuild air capabilities in violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @New_security8200/203000)
Hamas Internal Security Mechanism head Wael al-Ladawi and officer Ramz Abu Zureik were killed in a vehicle strike in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza. (Source: @New_security8200/202993)

Two Hamas operatives — weapons production commander Fares al-Masri and Nukhba Force member Mohammad Abu Shakian — were killed in separate Israeli strikes in northern Gaza last week. (Source: @manniefabian/58862)

Israeli security cabinet will discuss launching a pilot phase for basic services rehabilitation, humanitarian aid, and shelters in Rafah under a Palestinian technocrat government (NCAG) backed by multinational force ISF. (Source: @inon_yttach/9674)

Syrian President Al-Sharaa said Damascus is working on a security agreement with Israel with multiple countries, which could lead to comprehensive peace without relinquishing the Golan Heights, and ruled out military intervention in Lebanon. (Source: @inon_yttach/9673)

Iran announced it halted retaliatory attacks as long as the U.S. refrains from further strikes; the U.S. reportedly shelved escalation plans due to Patriot battery shortages. (Source: @pkpoi/143451, @Faytuks_Network/5736)

A tanker exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine; Iran committed to demining under the Islamabad understanding, while threats to target three oil tankers in Bab al-Mandab and Hormuz may drive oil prices to $110. (Source: @VahidOnline/77507, @naya_foriraq/85644)

sections.executive_summary: Iran's Supreme Leader's office published a letter from Mojtaba Khamenei to Hezbollah declaring defense of all Lebanese territory and a complete end to Israeli invasion as the primary condition for any war-ending agreement with the U.S. The IDF struck central Gaza, killing Hamas UAV commander Mahmoud Id, and separately eliminated two Hamas operatives in northern Gaza involved in weapons production and the Nukhba Force. Meanwhile, the Israeli security cabinet is set to discuss a pilot program for humanitarian rehabilitation in Rafah under a Palestinian technocrat government backed by a multinational force.

points: Mojtaba Khamenei's written letter to Hezbollah Secretary-General and senior officials states that Iran, per Ali Khamenei's policy lines, has defined defense of fighters as strategic policy; defense of all Lebanese territory and a complete, unconditional end to the Zionist regime's invasion is the first condition for any agreement to end the forced war with the aggressive U.S. (Source: @New_security8200/203002)
Iranian army announced it stopped its retaliatory attacks as long as the United States refrains from further attacks against Iran, according to Al Arabiya. (Source: @pkpoi/143451)
Official Iranian media reported explosions in the Bandar Abbas area, though no further details were provided. (Source: @asafroz/51900)

Tasnim news agency, close to the IRGC, claimed a tanker exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine; the tanker had deviated from the Iran-specified maritime route. Under the fifth clause of the Islamabad understanding signed in late Khordad, Iran committed to demine the Strait within 30 days to free ship passage. (Source: @VahidOnline/77507)

Head of Iranian National Security Committee Ibrahim Raisi stated any attack on Iran always comes at a cost, a fact the U.S. and Israel know well; he warned Ukraine may soon realize Iran does not allow actions without an answer. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/381093)

Ukraine's Ambassador to Israel Yevgen Kornitschuk confirmed a strike on an Iranian ship in the Caspian Sea, stating it carried components for drones and missiles bound for Iran, not civilian cargo, and called it a legitimate military target. (Source: @shin_persian/8529)

CENTCOM Commander Admiral Brad Cooper assessed that in a wide attack on Iran, the U.S. could cope with Patriot missile shortages by first severely damaging Iran's ability to launch missiles in large numbers, per U.S. officials speaking to the Wall Street Journal. (Source: @asafroz/51938)

IDF spokesperson confirmed forces eliminated Mahmoud Id, commander of Hamas's UAV squad in the central camps, in a strike in central Gaza; Id was responsible for UAV production targeting Israeli civilians and soldiers and had tried to rebuild Hamas's air array in violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @New_security8200/203000)

Two Hamas operatives were killed in Israeli strikes in northern Gaza last week: Fares al-Masri, a commander in Hamas's weapons production division involved in rebuilding capabilities violating the ceasefire, and Mohammad Abu Shakian, a member of Hamas's elite Nukhba Force; both worked to advance attacks on troops and Israeli civilians. (Source: @manniefabian/58862)

The Israeli security cabinet will discuss launching a pilot phase for rehabilitation of basic services in Gaza, humanitarian aid, and shelters in areas not controlled by Hamas, starting in Rafah; the plan includes temporary housing, strict vetting of residents, and administration by a Palestinian technocrat government (NCAG) backed by multinational force ISF. (Source: @inon_yttach/9674)
The Israeli government convened today at a secure, undisclosed location. (Source: @New_security8200/202986)

Prime Minister Netanyahu rejected Senator Lindsey Graham's proposal to join Israel in strikes against Hezbollah in Lebanon, stating the focus remains on Iran and that a broad strike on Hezbollah could remove their restraint and lead to all-out war, which is not in Israel's interest currently. (Source: @asafroz/51922)

IDF forces from the Shomron Brigade sealed the house of the terrorist who carried out the Friday shooting attack in which Maj. Yuval Ezra and Sgt. (res.) Binyahu Maltz were killed; the terrorist was eliminated immediately in the village of Tel; the sealing followed a Central Command order and demolition proceedings will continue. (Source: @New_security8200/202989)

Israeli forces arrested over 130 wanted persons across Judea and Samaria, including Hamas activists, arms dealers, and terrorists planning imminent attacks; dozens of inciters were also detained; entry of Palestinian workers to settlements is barred until Tuesday. (Source: @yediotnews25/133235)

Hamas Internal Security Mechanism head in the Central Governorate Wael al-Ladawi and officer Ramz Abu Zureik were killed in a vehicle strike in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza Strip. (Source: @New_security8200/202993)

IDF struck central Gaza and killed Mahmoud Id, commander of Hamas's UAV squad in the central camps, who was responsible for UAV production targeting Israeli civilians and soldiers and attempted to rebuild Hamas's air capabilities violating the ceasefire. (Source: @New_security8200/203000)

Two Hamas operatives were killed in northern Gaza last week: Fares al-Masri, commander in Hamas's weapons production division involved in rebuilding capabilities in violation of the ceasefire, and Mohammad Abu Shakian, a member of Hamas's elite Nukhba Force; both advanced attacks on troops and Israeli civilians. (Source: @manniefabian/58862)

Israeli security cabinet to discuss pilot phase for Gaza rehabilitation in Rafah, including temporary housing, strict vetting, and administration by Palestinian technocrat government (NCAG) backed by multinational force ISF. (Source: @inon_yttach/9674)

Israeli forces arrested over 130 wanted persons across the West Bank, including Hamas activists, arms dealers, and terrorists planning imminent attacks; dozens of inciters detained; Palestinian worker entry to settlements suspended until Tuesday. (Source: @yediotnews25/133235)

IDF sealed the house of the terrorist who carried out the Friday shooting attack killing Maj. Yuval Ezra and Sgt. (res.) Binyahu Maltz in the village of Tel; demolition proceedings to follow. (Source: @New_security8200/202989)
Israeli settlers set fire to a mosque in Qusra, southeast of Nablus in the occupied West Bank. (Source: @presstv/200451)
A suspected car-ramming attack occurred at Highway 1 Mitzpe Jericho junction; one wounded conscious. (Source: @pkpoi/143445)
Hezbollah launched a drone towards Israeli forces in the vicinity of Ali al-Tahir, per Israeli Army Radio. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/381076)
Israeli Army Radio reported Israeli forces fired at a Hezbollah drone flying over troops; the drone carried a camera for surveillance. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85673)

Red Alert Lebanon requested reports from residents in Beirut's southern suburbs on continued drone flights, urging use of alert bots to strengthen the home front. (Source: @redlinkleb/33097, @redlinkleb/33095)
A Hermes 900 unarmed drone was observed at high altitude over Shukin and surroundings. (Source: @redlinkleb/33090)

Mojtaba Khamenei's letter to Hezbollah emphasized defense of all Lebanese territory and a complete, unconditional end to Israeli invasion as the first condition for any agreement to end the forced war with the U.S. (Source: @New_security8200/203002)
Press TV reported Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei praised Hezbollah's steadfastness as an inspiring message to free nations. (Source: @presstv/200445)

Senator Lindsey Graham planned to persuade President Trump to join Israel in strikes against Hezbollah in Lebanon, but Netanyahu rejected the idea as too far-reaching amid the war against Iran. (Source: @asafroz/51922)

Syrian President Al-Sharaa told Al Jazeera that Damascus is working to reach a security agreement with Israel in partnership with several countries; if successful, it could pave the way for comprehensive peace without relinquishing Syria's right to the Golan Heights. (Source: @inon_yttach/9673)
Al-Sharaa explicitly stated Syria will not intervene militarily in Lebanon. (Source: @inon_yttach/9673)
N12 foreign desk noted the success of a security agreement with Israel may pave the way for peace without harming Syria's right to the Golan Heights. (Source: @N12chat/219306)

Reports indicate threats to target three commercial and oil tankers — two in Bab al-Mandab and one in Hormuz — as Iran 'plays with Trump's nerves'; oil prices may reach $110 at market opening. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85644)
The number of U.S. tankers in the region has doubled since the 40-day war; behind negotiation news, a larger war than the 40-day conflict may be approaching. (Source: @kianmeli1/90109)
U.S. Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz stated President Trump is giving diplomacy with Iran a chance. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5755)

Senator Lindsey Graham flew to meet Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to convince him to support a war against Iran; Graham claimed after the fall of the Iranian regime, normalization between Israel and Saudi Arabia would be pursued with bipartisan support. (Source: @asafroz/51923)

President Trump decided to set aside plans to sharply escalate military operations against Iran after a meeting with top advisers, citing a shortage of air-defense systems, particularly Patriot batteries. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/5736)

CENTCOM Commander Admiral Brad Cooper assessed the U.S. could cope with Patriot shortages in a wide attack on Iran by first severely damaging Iran's ability to launch missiles in large numbers. (Source: @asafroz/51938)
